_what: Head size in the installed cut-out's pixels, read at 2x on gridded crops of public/art/characters/leblanc/<state>.png: W = the bob's width across the head's axis (hair tip to hair tip), L = crown to chin along the axis (for ko, lying on her side: the head's horizontal and vertical extent). The size used is sqrt(W x L), so a foreshortened length (cast looks up) or a wide profile bob (attack) does not decide it alone.
